correctness.rationale: Let \(b=2^t\). Bi-unitary harmonicity gives \((p+1)(p^2+1)B\mid 8bp^3q^{2b}\), where \(B=\sum_{j=0}^{2b}q^j-q^b\). Because \(b\) is a power of two, prime-support forcing and \(\gcd(p+1,p^2+1)=2\) reduce the first factor to \(p+1=2^u\), \(p^2+1=2q^v\), so \(q\equiv1\pmod4\). Also \(B\equiv1\pmod q\), while even \(b\) gives \(q+1\mid B\); hence \(q+1=2p^s\). Size comparisons force \(s=v=1\), then \(p=3,q=5\). For that pair harmonicity would require \(B\mid216b\), but \(B>25^b>216b\) for every \(b\ge2\), contradiction. The finite verifier is consistent with the argument but is not used as the infinite proof.
